title: cymbopogon connatus
intro: Cymbopogon connatus, commonly known as East Indian lemongrass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, which include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, helping to protect against infections, reduce pain and inflammation, and neutralize free radicals in the body. The therapeutic actions of Cymbopogon connatus include its use in aromatherapy to promote relaxation and reduce stress, as well as its application in traditional medicine to treat digestive issues and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
